title: Velora
description: Simple, lightweight modpack focused on performance improvements and useful quality-of-life features.
body:
Velora is a lightweight optimization-focused Fabric modpack that enhances **performance**, **stability**, and **smoothness** while staying true to the vanilla experience. It includes essential optimization mods, helpful quality-of-life improvements, and subtle visual polish for a more refined way to play. This modpack is also actively maintained and intended to stay **up to date** over time.

## Compatibility
Velora does not include any content-expanding mods, so it remains purely client-side and works on any server without requiring server-side installation

## Lightweight
Velora is designed to stay lightweight by including only carefully selected mods that improve performance, stability, and quality of life without adding unnecessary bloat.

## Up to Date
Velora is actively maintained and updated with improvements and fixes, with new Minecraft versions being supported as quickly as possible

## Strong Foundation for Your Own Modpack
Velora also serves as a solid base for creating your own modpack. It can easily be expanded with additional mods to match your personal preferences or project goals.
